# Effects

Effects are lines that do something. 175 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Add {#add}

```carve
add %object% to %variable%
```

Adds to a number variable, or appends to a list (`add "x" and "y" to {list::*}`).

```carve
add 1 to {joins::%uuid of player%}
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Add or remove items {#inventory_items}

```carve
add %item% to %player%'s inventory
remove %item% from %player%['s inventory]
```

Adds items to, or takes up to that many items from, a player's inventory.

```carve
remove 2 diamonds from player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Allow flight {#allow_flight}

```carve
(allow|enable) (fly|flight) (for|to) %object%
(disallow|disable) (fly|flight) (for|to) %object%
```

Lets a player fly (double-tap jump) or takes it away. Only the permission changes; `make player fly` also starts the flight.

```carve
allow flight for player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w6-chunk2](../syntax/w6-chunk2.md)

## apply %object% to %player% {#apply_object_to_player}

```carve
apply %object% to %player%
```

_No description yet._

Since **unreleased**

## Apply potion effect {#apply_potion}

```carve
apply [potion of] <effect> [[of tier] %number%] to %player% [for %timespan%]
```

Gives a potion effect. The number is the tier (default 1); the time defaults to 15 seconds.

```carve
apply potion of speed 2 to player for 10 seconds
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Ban {#ban}

```carve
ban ip %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% by ip [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
```

Bans a player or name, or their IP, with an optional reason.

```carve
ban "Alex" because of "cheating"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Ban for a time {#ban_for}

```carve
ban %object% [(because of|by reason of|due to|with reason) %text%] for %timespan%
ban ip %object% [(because of|by reason of|due to|with reason) %text%] for %timespan%
```

A ban that ends by itself. The player has to be online; Pumpkin's ban list needs a UUID, which a plain name does not give. A later `ban` without a time is permanent.

```carve
ban player because of "spam" for 2 hours
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w6-chunk2](../syntax/w6-chunk2.md)

## Cancel command cooldown {#cancel_cooldown}

```carve
(cancel|ignore) [the] [current] [command] cooldown
(uncancel|unignore) [the] [current] [command] cooldown
```

In a command with `cooldown:`: this use does not start the cooldown. Commands take `cooldown:`, `cooldown message:` (with `%remaining time%`, `%elapsed time%`, `%cooldown time%`) and `cooldown bypass:` (a permission). Cooldowns are per player and kept in memory.

```carve
command /heal:
    cooldown: 1 minute
    cooldown message: Wait %remaining time%.
    trigger:
        heal player
        cancel the cooldown
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w5-chunk1](../syntax/w5-chunk1.md)

## Cancel drops {#cancel_drops}

```carve
(cancel|clear|delete) [the] drops
(cancel|clear|delete) [the] drops of items
(cancel|clear|delete) [the] drops of (xp|experience)
```

In `on break` and `on death`: nothing (or no items, or no experience) is dropped.

```carve
on break:
    cancel the drops
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w5-chunk1](../syntax/w5-chunk1.md)

## Cancel event {#cancel}

```carve
cancel [the] event
```

Stops the event. Works before the first `wait`. Some events cannot be cancelled; using it there is a load error.

```carve
on chat:
    cancel event
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [effects](../syntax/effects.md)

## Change an inventory value {#inventory_value_effects}

```carve
set slot %number% of %inventory% to %item%
open %inventory% (to|for) %player%
clear %inventory%
```

Sets a slot, opens the inventory as a chest menu, or empties it. Changing a slot of a variable also changes the menus open from it. `clear` on a variable that holds no inventory deletes the variable.

```carve
set {_gui} to chest inventory named "Shop"
set slot 0 of {_gui} to stone
open {_gui} to player
clear {_gui}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Change barter drops {#w5c3_barter_drops}

```carve
set [the] (barter|bartering) drops to %object%
add %object% to [the] (barter|bartering) drops
remove %object% from [the] (barter|bartering) drops
(clear|delete|reset) [the] (barter|bartering) drops
```

In `on piglin barter`: change the drops list the script sees. Pumpkin 0.2.2 copies only `cancelled` back from the event, so the piglin still throws its own drops; cancel the event to stop them.

```carve
on piglin barter:
    set barter drops to 3 diamonds
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w5-chunk3](../syntax/w5-chunk3.md)

## Change damage {#damage_change}

```carve
set [the] damage to %number%
add %number% to [the] damage
remove %number% from [the] damage
```

Changes the damage of the hit in `on damage` (never below 0). Only a change before the first `wait` reaches the server.

```carve
on damage of player:
    if damage > 6:
        set damage to 6
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Change health {#health}

```carve
set health of %player% to %number%
set %player%'s health to %number%
add %number% to health of %player%
add %number% to %player%'s health
remove %number% from health of %player%
```

Sets, raises or lowers health (20 = 10 hearts). Values are kept between 0 and max health; 0 kills.

## Create, load or unload a world {#create_world}

```carve
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% [with environment (normal|nether|end)]
load world %text%
unload world %text%
create [a] [new] world [named] %text%
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% with environment (normal|overworld)
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% with environment nether
create [a] [new] world [named] %text% with environment end
load world [named] %text%
unload world [named] %text%
```

Creates a world (or loads it when it exists) or unloads one. Names are letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`. A refusal from the server is a script error with the reason.

```carve
on join:
    create world "arena" with environment nether
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-skbee-raytrace-world](../syntax/w4-skbee-raytrace-world.md)

## Edit the held item {#held_item_meta}

```carve
set [the] name of %player%'s tool to %text%
(reset|clear|delete) [the] name of %player%'s tool
set [the] lore of %player%'s tool to %texts%
add %texts% to [the] lore of %player%'s tool
(reset|clear|delete) [the] lore of %player%'s tool
enchant %player%'s tool with %enchantments%
disenchant %player%'s tool
```

Changes the name, lore or enchantments of the item in the player's main hand. `player's held item` and `tool of player` work too. An empty hand does nothing. `disenchant` removes every enchantment.

```carve
set name of player's tool to "&6Excalibur"
set lore of player's tool to "&7Legendary" and "&7Sharp"
add "&8Line 3" to lore of player's tool
enchant player's tool with sharpness 5 and unbreaking 3
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [item-meta](../syntax/item-meta.md)

## Enable, disable and reload script {#script_switch}

```carve
(enable|load) script [(file|named)] %text% [with errors]
reload script [(file|named)] %text% [with errors]
(disable|unload) script [(file|named)] %text% [with errors]
```

Runs `/carve enable`, `/carve reload` or `/carve disable` for a script file. `unload` disables the script (the file is renamed with a `-`).

```carve
reload script "homes"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w6-chunk2](../syntax/w6-chunk2.md)

## Equip {#equip_items}


```carve
set %player%'s gamemode to %text% [mode]
set %player%'s game mode to %text% [mode]
```

Changes the game mode. The mode can be a word, text, a number 0 to 3 or a short form (`s`, `c`, `a`, `sp`).

```carve
set gamemode of player to creative
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [gamemode](../syntax/gamemode.md)

## Set metadata {#set_metadata}

```carve
set metadata value %text% of %object% to %object%
```

Stores a metadata value on an entity or block. Metadata is lost on restart.

## Set persistent data {#set_persistent_data}

```carve
set persistent data value %text% of %object% to %object%
```

Stores a value on an entity, block or item that survives restarts.

## Set quit message {#set_quit_message}

```carve
set [the] (quit|leave) message to %text%
```

Changes the message everyone sees when the player leaves. Only in `on quit`. Color codes work.

```carve
on quit:
    set quit message to "&e%player% left"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## Set slot {#set_slot}

```carve
set slot %number% of %inventory% to %item%
```

Puts an item in a slot (counted from 0). `air` empties it. `player's current inventory` is the open Carve menu.

```carve
set slot 4 of player's current inventory to diamond
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Set velocity {#set_velocity}

```carve
set [the] velocity of %entities% to %vector%
```

Sets the whole velocity of players or entities. Each part is cut to -20 to 20.

```carve

```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [entities](../syntax/entities.md)

## Shear and unshear {#shear}

```carve
shear %object%
unshear %object%
```

Shears a sheep (the wool grows back with `unshear`). Sheep only; the wool is not dropped.

```carve
spawn a sheep at player
shear last spawned entity
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w6-chunk2](../syntax/w6-chunk2.md)

## Shoot (section) {#c6_shoot}

```carve
shoot %entity type% [from %entity%] [(at|with) (speed|velocity) %number%]:
```

Spawns a projectile in front of the shooter's eyes moving where they look (default speed 5) and runs the body with `event-entity` as the projectile. The projectile has no owner.

```carve
shoot an arrow from player at speed 2:
    send "%type of event-entity%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w5-chunk6](../syntax/w5-chunk6.md)

_No description yet._

```carve
make %object% not silent
```

Stops an entity from making sounds, or lets it again.

Sorts a list in place. Numbers sort by value, before text.

Shuts the server down.

## Stop sound {#stop_sound}

```carve
stop all sounds [(for|from) %player%]
stop [the] (sound|sounds) %text% [(for|from) %player%]
```

Stops one sound or all sounds for a player.

```carve

```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [sounds](../syntax/sounds.md)

## Stop sound in a category {#stop_sound_category}

```carve
stop (sound|sounds) %text% (in|from) [the] <category> [(from playing to|for|to) %object%]
stop all (sound|sounds) (in|from) [the] <category> [(from playing to|for|to) %object%]
```

Stops a named sound, or every sound, of one category: master, music, record, weather, block, hostile, neutral, player, ambient, voice. Without a player it goes to the one who started the trigger.


## Tame and untame {#tame}

```carve

```

Tames a wolf or a cat, with the player who started the trigger as the owner, or frees it. Other tameable animals are not supported.

```carve

```

## Teleport {#teleport}


Teleports the player to coordinates in their current world.


## Teleport to location {#teleport_location}

```carve
teleport %player% to %location%
```

Teleports the player to a location. A location without a world keeps the player in their world.


## Wait {#wait}

```carve
wait %number% (tick|ticks)

```

Pauses the run without blocking the server. A timespan is rounded to the nearest tick.


## While loop {#while}

```carve

```

Runs the block while the condition holds. Checked before every round.

```carve

    add 1 to {_i}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [loops](../syntax/loops.md)

## Zombify villager {#zombify}

```carve
zombify %object%
unzombify %object%
```

Replaces a villager with a zombie villager at the same spot, keeping its name and health (and back). Pumpkin has no conversion call, so this is a replacement.

```carve
spawn a villager at player
zombify last spawned entity
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w6-chunk2](../syntax/w6-chunk2.md)
